usage: 廁所 (bathroom) is a noun used to refer to the place where you go to use the toilet or wash up.
You can use 廁所 to ask for the location of the bathroom, for example, '廁所喺邊？' means 'Where is the bathroom?'.
The word 廁所 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我去廁所。' means 'I am going to the bathroom.'
廁所 is commonly used in both formal and informal speech when talking about homes, restaurants, or public places.
To use 廁所 politely, you can add a question particle like 吖 (aa3) or 呀 (aa3) when asking for directions.
